_meta.title: v6p5 local high-res observation (mid360 near-full range)
_meta.summary: Use local observation crop with near-full-map range for forest_a and increase obs_map_size to 64.

self_check: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --self-check
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --self-check

smoke.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --episodes 300 --out v6p5_smoke300
smoke.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --models v6p5_smoke300 --runs 3 --out v6p5_smoke300

full.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p5 --out v6p5_full3000
full.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p5 --models v6p5_full3000 --runs 20 --out v6p5_full3000

key_hparams.obs_local_note: forest_a map is ~36m x 36m; range=18m is near full-map coverage
